headline: DeepSeek hits 13.7% — day 3 at the top
summary: DeepSeek's v4-flash just set an all-time token-share record at 13.7%, extending its three-day reign at #1. Tencent's hy3 claimed its own peak at 12.3% and holds #2, while Google took a 4.2-point hit overnight—a sharp reversal that shuffled the entire leaderboard. Three new models entered the rankings, and InclusionAI's ling-3.0 dropped out after holding #23.
highlights: DeepSeek now owns 25.7% of total provider share, up 1.1 points in a day and 5.9 points in a week
Tencent's hy3 hit 12.3% token share—a new record for the model
Google fell 5 ranks overnight (rank 3 → 8), losing 4.2 points of share in 24 hours
OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna climbed 2 spots to #4 despite the chaos
Three debuts: OpenAI's gpt-oss-20b (#49), Qwen's qwen3.7-flash (#50), and OpenAI's gpt-5.5 (#51)
